defects.at: 47.84–53.20, designer x 960–1260, y 150–480 (F1 page, lib/sites.js sokoPageCanvas; visible in every s17 frame)
defects.what: The designer does not look like the source character. The render has long, straight, lank hair with a centre part hanging to the shoulders (x 960–990 and 1150–1180, y 300–420). It has a round cartoon face with four freckle dots, flat cartoon eyes with thick upper lids, a flat white shirt covered in scratchy mechanical X-hatching, and oversized pale concentric-ring headphone cups on his neck (r≈30 px). The source has short, messy, choppy hair ending at the jaw, with bangs across the eyes. Its face is gaunt and shaded, with sweat drops, heavy-lidded almond eyes and thin lid lines. The shirt is shaded with fold lines and a collar, and the neck cups are smaller and dark (r≈22). The source also has the laptop's light blooming on his face, neck and shoulder; the render has none (shirt p95 238 vs 252, face region 151 vs 164 at 50.04). The gaze matches: both look screen-left, verified at 5x.
defects.fix: F1 owner: redraw the hair as about 15 tapered dark strands ending at y≈330, with bangs over (1000–1130, 240–300), and remove the shoulder-length side locks. Replace the cheek dots with 3–4 small teardrop sweat marks. Draw the eye lids as 1 px lines. Shrink the neck cups to r≈22, value ≈0.25, with a single pale rim. Replace the X-hatch on the shirt with sleeve and fold lines, darker on his left side. Add a soft light bloom of about +0.15 value, radius ≈120 px, centred near (1060, 420). As a stop-gap, s17/page.js can patch the head and bloom locally, as it already does for the head turn.

defects.at: 47.84–53.20, lower half and room gear (F1 page)
defects.what: Most of the full-frame error is in the page, not the owl. The trousers (x 1000–1250, y 560–800) are bright, smooth white blotches where the source has dark, engraved, crumpled cloth. The sneakers (y 800–900) are cartoon drawings; the source's are laced and detailed. The cables are straight verticals; the source's loop. The big guitar case at far left (x 0–160, y 380–900) is missing. The amp (x 330–560, y 700–850) is a flat box with no handle. The backpack at right (x 1840–2000, y 560–780) is a wireframe mesh that looks unfinished. The engraving on the gear is lower in contrast than the source: p95 is 20–25 lower (left gear 192 vs 214, right gear 159 vs 183) and p50 is 3–10 higher.
defects.fix: F1 owner: re-engrave the trousers with the value study at about 0.2–0.35, with white fold highlights only. Add the guitar case silhouette at x 0–160 and fill the backpack as a solid engraved plate. Loop the cables. Raise the engraving contrast on the gear: stroke gain +10%, and pull the shadow floor down so the gear's p50 ≈10–15 and p95 ≈185–215.

defects.what: The 3-tap radial shutter makes stepped double and triple ghost edges and moiré where the source has a smooth radial smear. At 47.96, see the keyboard keys at x 2060–2206, y 500–946 and the stand bracket and cables at x 0–300, y 600–946. The render is too sharp: Laplacian sharpness is 1.20–1.33× the source at 47.92–48.00 and 1.14–1.18× at 48.04–48.16. More than 800 px from the zoom centre (865, 341) it is 1.5–2.0× the source.
defects.fix: Raise NBLUR to 10–12 and SHUTTER to about 0.012 s, so the smear is continuous rather than three copies. Or keep the taps and add an extra radial softening, e.g. openBlur σ 1.0 at 47.92, 0.8 at 47.96–48.00, 0.6 at 48.04–48.16, 0.3 at 48.24 and 0 from 48.36. Re-check the sharpness ratio: aim for 0.95–1.05 overall and at the periphery.

defects.at: 52.68–53.20 dash, face-on headphone cup (s17/owlDraw.js), e.g. 53.00 at about (549, 444), r≈19
defects.what: The face-on cup is shaded like a sphere: an off-centre pale boss at upper right, a smooth gradient from about 120 to 216 and a dark crescent low down (67–75 at y 458–462). It reads as a grey ball or nose stuck on the side of the head. The source's cup is concentric: a darker centre boss (~144, r≤4), a bright plate ring (~178, r 6–12), a dark cushion ring (~112–117, r 14–18) and then a pale rim.
defects.fix: Remove the radial highlight gradient. Draw flat concentric bands at those values and radii, scaled by the pose's s: boss 0.56, plate 0.70, cushion 0.44, 1.5 px dark outline on the plate edge. Keep the heavier dark cushion low down.

defects.what: The wings and body read as white cut-outs with faint scribbles. The dark-outlined, scalloped trailing-edge tips of the secondaries are missing (e.g. 51.64 at x 650–700, y 505–517, where the render has a flat white edge straight onto the speaker). So are the individual primary separations. The body and tail contour is weak (52.00, x 700–760, y 520–545). The builder's own measure puts line energy 20–30% below the source in the rise and about 40% below in the dash.
defects.fix: Along each traced wing outline in wing_data, stroke the trailing-edge scallops as tapered 1.5–2 px arcs, value ≈0.35. Add a ~2 px keyline, value ≈0.55, on the lower body and tail silhouette. Make the side-cup rings irregular: 2 rings, with a thicker soft shadow ring on the plate's left edge.

defects.at: 52.68–52.92 dash head silhouette (sil_data clip), e.g. 52.68 at about (655–690, 420–440) and 52.92 at about (485–505, 400–420)
defects.what: There are black jagged slits under the headband, and the head outline is jagged and fuzzy. The source's head outline is smooth, with only a thin gap under the band.
defects.fix: Close gaps narrower than 6 px in the traced head polygon only in the sector under the band arc: a 2 px morphological close, or a union with a head ellipse shrunk by 2 px limited to the top-left quadrant. Leave the real band gap 1–2 px wide.

defects.what: The beak is a large grey cone with a dark outline and a dark centre stroke, about 1.5× the source's size, and it reads as a carrot nose. The source's beak is small and pale with a thin outline, and it is open (split) at 52.56 and 52.60. The plaster is filled mid-grey (~170); the source's is pale (~215) with thin stripes.
defects.fix: Scale the dash beak to about 0.65, with fill 0.85 and a 1 px outline at 0.45, and drop the centre stroke. Draw an open, split beak at 52.56 and 52.60. Set the plaster fill to 0.85 with two 0.6 px grey stripes.

defects.what: The eyes sit about 6 px left of the source's at 52.52 (rings at (707, 417) and (740, 408) against (713, 418) and (746, 410)) and about 4 px left at 52.60. The render's rings are thin and uniform; the source's are heavier low down, with iris texture.

defects.what: A 5×6 px dark notch in the owl's white is a slit left by the tracer at the wing and body junction.
defects.fix: Close slits narrower than 6 px where the wing polygon meets the body polygon, e.g. join a 3 px dilation of the body polygon to the clip there.

defects.what: The mug is a smooth vector gradient with no engraving; the source's mug has vertical brush and hatch texture and a darker lower band. The left handle is too dark: max 70 vs the source's 147 at x 800–818, y 485–515.

defects.what: The headline starts too dim. The letters' p99 is 89 vs 132 at 47.84 and 109 vs 122 at 47.88. From 47.92 on it matches within about 5.

defects.what: Measured with ORB relative to 47.92, the render is 0.5–0.9% off the source: 2.170/1.956/1.778 against 2.151/1.967/1.788 at 47.80/47.84/47.88. That is about 6 px at the frame edges. From 47.92 on the camera matches within 0.1% at every frame.

The locked shot is about 7% softer than the source (Laplacian 9.3 vs 10.0). Switching from the composite path to direct drawing adds a 4% sharpness step at 48.52→48.56; the source changes by 1% there.

defects.at: Global post (post.js, not s17): pure-black areas
defects.what: Blacks are lifted to about 1.5 with grain std 1.4; the source has 0.2 and std 0.4. The render's black also has a slight blue cast (63.5/64.5/64.8) where the source's is slightly green (60.4/62.0/61.0).

defects.what: steam_data.js stores a pre-grade value sampled from source pixels for each steam point. That is sampled source luminance, which may breach the 'no pixel of the source' rule. Production code still reads the lab hooks globalThis.__S17 (owlDraw.js lines 25–26, 928, 950; DBG in s17.js). The 103 KB ill.js is dead code.
defects.fix: Replace the per-point sampled values with a small hand-set value curve (e.g. 3–4 keyed values per wisp), or get sign-off that it is acceptable. Strip the __S17 hooks from the film build and delete ill.js.

verdict:
s17 is an 'approx' shot. Its staging, timing and camera match the source closely, but the drawing is visibly simpler, mostly in F1's page, then in the owl's interior line work and in the pull-back periphery.

**Verified as matching:**
- **Camera:** from 47.92 to 48.56 the per-frame zoom is within 0.1% of the source (e.g. 1.3296 vs 1.3290 at 48.04, 1.0674 vs 1.0672 at 48.28) and the fixed point is (865, 341). The first frames, 47.80–47.88, are 0.5–0.9% off.
- **Cadence:** checked frame by frame at 49.08–49.20, 49.44–49.64, 51.44–51.64 and 52.40–53.20. The owl's drawing changes land on the same source frames, including the 3-frame holds, the switch to ones at 52.52 and the repeated drawing at 53.04.
- **Owl:** the traced silhouettes put its path and poses in the right place, and the steam follows the source.
- **Head turn** (52.80–53.20): matches within 0.125 px.
- **Gaze:** the designer looks screen-left in both (checked at 5x).
- **UI:** the header, counter, key and nav are almost identical.
- **Cuts:** the first frame is 47.84, and 47.80 is correctly borrowed by s16; the last frame is 53.20, with s18 from 53.24.
- **Errors:** no placeholder text or red error bars.

**Numbers:** full-frame σ6 MAE is 9.55–10.2 on locked frames, 11.7–14.2 during the pull-back, and 15.2 on s16's borrowed frame at 47.80.

**Tool caveat:** the pairs at 47.82, 47.86, 53.22 and 53.26 look like cut errors, but they are an artifact of compare.sh.
- The render is seeked at a time floored to 30 fps, while the reference frame is taken by ffmpeg `-ss`, which gives the next source frame.
- At exact n/25 times, the cut frames match.
- Pair index 07 is missing in every compare run; I extracted those reference frames myself.
- One run failed with a 'detached Frame' error from the snapshot tool under load. I re-ran it, and no error came from the shot.

**Determinism:** bit-identical (max pixel difference 0) across separate compare runs at 47.84, 48.52, 50.00, 52.60 and 52.64. This covers both the composite pull-back path and the dash on ones. On holds, the static page changes by no more than the source's grain.

**Most visible defects:**
1. The designer's likeness and missing laptop light (F1).
2. The trousers, shoes and gear, and low-contrast engraving (F1).
3. Stepped ghosting and moiré from the 3-tap shutter in the pull-back (s17).
4. The face-on headphone cup drawn as a shaded ball in the dash (s17).
5. The owl's sparse feather and edge line work (s17).
